# ezghcloud_invitation (Resource)

Manage an EZGH Cloud invitation.

## Schema

- `expires_in_days` (Number) Requested lifetime in seconds (900 to 31536000).

- `policy_ids` (Set of String) The policyIds values.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Replace identifiers with values from your organization.
terraform import ezghcloud_invitation.example 'ORGANIZATION_ID/INVITATION_ID'
```
